'''Orkana''', also known as the '''Poisoned Land''', was a heavily polluted territory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the domain of [[Orko]],<ref name="Orkana" /> a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] trader of the lower [[H'uun]] caste,<ref name="Orko">{{CSWECite|II|424|Orko (the Foultrader)}}</ref> and was the location of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Orko's palace|palace]].<ref name="Murder Most Foul" />
